notes_for_editor: Height 105 ft (NRHP) vs 108 ft (museum, LighthouseFriends); Armour retired 1906 (USLHS, museum) vs 1908 (LighthouseFriends); Seabrook 1946 (USLHS) vs 1947 (LighthouseFriends). The Franklin Seabrook hand-turned-lens story is from LighthouseFriends only; the 1928 Bulletin (PDF p. 31) confirms the September hurricane damaged Jupiter (17 Sept vs LighthouseFriends' 16 Sept warnings) and gives an August 7 storm report. Cost: NRHP $60,858.98 vs LighthouseFriends $60,859.98. Armour retirement 1906 (USLHS, museum) vs 1908 (LF). Roster is a partial selection of the USLHS list (assistants after 1866 not entered). The 1861 removal, Victor wreck (1872) and 1927 fire are secondary-sourced (no Light-House Board 1861 report in the corpus). Roster is from USLHS/NARA; names not cross-checked in registers. Museum history PDF is cited for the Raynolds/Yorke detail; NRHP credits Nystrom. Not cited: 1895 Hillsboro paragraph quoted from the Board's yearly repeated recommendation.
